W.note: Counts exactly 5-7-5 (Na-cre-ous at dusk / rain-bows bloom on a thin veil / gone be-fore we look), names nacreous clouds and evokes their iridescence accurately, though 'thin veil' is a soft stock image and 'gone before we look' is a familiar closing move.

X.note: Counts 5-5-6 (the am-ber band fades / a thin blue-white streak / stars still show-ing a-bove), so the middle line is short and the shape is loose; the amber band and streak are vivid but the cloud is never clearly identified as rare, and the double dash and trailing spaces add markdown clutter.

Y.note: Counts 6-8-6 (sun gone be-hind the ridge / one cloud keeps its moth-er-of-pearl / un-til the grey comes in), so it misses 5-7-5 and is not a tight short-long-short; the nacreous mother-of-pearl image and the cloud holding its colour until the grey arrives land well.

Z.note: Counts exactly 5-7-5 (moth-er-of-pearl sky / a cloud no one has named yet / drifts past the moun-tain); the unnamed-cloud conceit is a fresh turn on rarity, though the mountain image is sparse and the premise sits loosely against nacreous clouds being named.
